Or simply:
$$ \text{Value}_{2010} = \text{Value}_{2009} \times \left( \frac{\text{Value}_{2009}}{\text{Value}_{2008}} \right) $$

Using the ratio method:
$$ \text{Value}_{2010} = 2,279 \times \left( \frac{2,279}{2,015} \right) $$
$$ \text{Value}_{2010} = 2,279 \times 1.1309975 $$
$$ \text{Value}_{2010} \approx 2,577.53 $$
